title: Tiefgang – an underwater roguelite co-op FPS built mostly by autonomous AI agents (Godot 4) – gameplay video
author: Substantial-Mix-3772
selftext:
Hey r/aigamedev!  
I'm a solo dev, and for the past few weeks I've been building **Tiefgang**, a roguelite co-op FPS set in sunken underwater temples. Most of the code was written by autonomous AI coding agents working from a single master spec.

💦 Gameplay video: [Gameplay video](https://youtu.be/mLpezN56qNA?is=hCHxzReMI2Hmss6C)

🥵 Play it free: [https://osugerman.itch.io/tiefgang](https://osugerman.itch.io/tiefgang)

**My workflow:**  
**Code:** AI agents working autonomously in Godot 4 / GDScript, guided by a detailed SPEC.md plus an agent rules file (progress tracking, task list, capped testing time so they keep coding instead of over-testing)  
**Concept art:** Higgsfield  
**3D models:** Meshy (image-to-3D) → Blender MCP for cleanup, rigging and LODs → .glb into Godot  
**Me:** design, direction, playtesting and fixing what the agents get wrong  
Happy to answer questions about the setup. And I'd love feedback on the game itself: what still screams "AI-made", and where does it hold up?
